title: RACA: Representation-Aware Coverage Criteria for LLM Safety Testing
reasoning: The paper focuses on developing a technical framework (RACA) and coverage criteria to improve the adequacy of LLM safety testing against jailbreak attacks. While it defines safety in the context of avoiding content that violates 'safety or ethical guidelines', the research is primarily concerned with software testing metrics (neuron and representation coverage) rather than evaluating religious beliefs, moral reasoning, or specific ethical systems.
